title: 第23章 秒杀圣王覆灭血影楼第24章 见未来之魂问未来之事
slug: 开局亿年修为弹指间秒杀一切
content_zh:
一天后。
血影楼派出的圣王境强者终于抵达了飞仙宗。
这一天一大早，整个飞仙宗上空被一团黑云所笼罩。
下面，宗门内的气氛变得格外压抑。
“这就是飞仙宗？”
“最强也不过一个化神境，楼主竟然派我来对付这么一个小势力。”
“你们直接出手吧。”
“一群蝼蚁，还不配我动手。”
“赶紧办完事情，我也好赶紧回去。”
“青州这种地方，连灵力都是如此稀薄，难怪是东荒最弱的一片地方。”
飞仙宗高空中，那名圣王境强者不屑开口道。
“是！”
下一刻，其余血影楼的人异口同声回应道。
紧接着，几名圣人境强者，再加上百名不弱于渡劫境的人，一同朝着下方的飞仙宗发动了猛烈攻击。
霎那间，铺天盖地的招式直逼飞仙宗而去。
“这是什么？”
“难道我们就要死了？！”
“不！我还不想死！”
“我上有八十岁老母，下有三岁小儿，我还不能死……”
“谁来救救我们！”

“……”
下方，飞仙宗内的弟子早就已经彻底绝望。
仅仅是在那些攻击招式的威压之下，他们就无法动弹分毫，更不要说四散逃命。
“哼，蝼蚁就是蝼蚁。”
“面对死亡，只会跪地求饶。”
“只可惜，你们惹了我血影楼，谁来也救不了你们。”
高空中，看着下面绝望哀求的飞仙宗弟子，血影楼的人都是露出无比讥笑的脸面。
但很快，他们就彻底笑不出来了。
就在攻击即将落下的时候，刹那间，整个飞仙宗都陷入了诡异之中。
不论是那些攻击，亦或是飞仙宗的弟子，他们都直接一动不动在原地，好似时间静止了一般。
“嗯？怎么回事？”
“这力量……”
“原来如此，难怪楼主会派我前来。”
“阁下既然出手了，那就出来一见吧。”
感受到出手之人手段的强大之处，圣王境强者顿时淡淡开口朝着下方开口道。
声音落下，一道身影便凭空出现在圣王境强者的对面。
来人正是李如风。
“圣王，还有五个圣人。”
content_en:
One day later.
The Saint King Realm experts sent by the Blood Shadow Tower finally arrived at the Feixian Sect.
Early that morning, the entire Feixian Sect was shrouded in a black cloud.
Below, the atmosphere within the sect became particularly depressing.
"Is this the Feixian Sect?"
"The strongest one is only in the realm of God Transformation. The host actually sent me to deal with such a small force."
"You just take action."
"A bunch of ants are not worthy of my taking action."
"Hurry up and finish the work so that I can go back quickly."
"In a place like Qingzhou, even spiritual power is so thin. No wonder it is the weakest place in the Eastern Wasteland."
High in the sky of Feixian Sect, the Saint King Realm expert said disdainfully.
"Yes!"
The next moment, the rest of the people in the Blood Shadow Studio responded in unison.
Immediately afterwards, several strong men in the saint realm, plus a hundred people who were not weaker than the Tribulation Realm, launched a fierce attack on the Feixian Sect below.
In an instant, overwhelming moves were approaching Feixian Sect.
"What is this?"
"Are we going to die?!"
"No! I don't want to die yet!"
"I have an eighty-year-old mother and a three-year-old son. I can't die yet..."
"Someone come and save us!"
"..."
Below, the disciples in the Feixian Sect had already completely despaired.
Just under the pressure of those attack moves, they were unable to move at all, let alone flee for their lives.
"Huh, ants are just ants."
"Facing death, I will just kneel down and beg for mercy."
"It's a pity that you have offended my Blood Shadow Studio, and no one can save you."
High in the sky, looking at the desperately pleading Feixian Sect disciples below, the people in the Blood Shadow Tower had extremely sneering faces.
But soon, they stopped laughing at all.
Just when the attack was about to fall, in an instant, the entire Feixian Sect fell into strangeness.
Whether it was those attacking or the disciples of Feixian Sect, they all remained motionless in place, as if time had stopped.
"Huh? What's going on?"
"This power..."
"I see. No wonder the host sent me here."
"Since your Excellency has taken action, come out and see me."
Feeling the power of the person who took action, the Saint King Realm expert suddenly spoke calmly and spoke downwards.
As the voice fell, a figure appeared out of thin air opposite the Saint King Realm powerhouse.
The person coming was none other than Li Rufeng.
"Holy King, there are five more saints."
